name: Green Leaf Café
description: A popular expat-friendly café and co-working space in the heart of Bangkok's Silom district. Known for excellent specialty coffee, home-cooked food, and a genuinely welcoming team. We hire internationally and provide on-site orientation for all new staff.

name: Blue Horizon Dive School
description: One of Koh Tao's longest-running PADI dive schools, offering everything from beginner Open Water courses to Divemaster training. Our team of 12 instructors comes from 8 different countries. Consistently rated among the top dive schools on the island.

name: Lanna Language Academy
description: A boutique language school serving students, professionals, and expats in northern Thailand for over a decade. Our English programmes focus on practical communication skills. Small class sizes (max 10 students) ensure genuine learning outcomes.

name: Serenity Ubud Retreat
description: An eco-friendly yoga and wellness retreat nestled in the rice paddies of Ubud, Bali. We host week-long retreats for international guests and run a small school for aspiring yoga teachers. All produce is grown on-site or sourced locally.

name: Pai Mountain Farm
description: A small family-run permaculture farm in the mountains of northern Thailand. We practice no-till farming, seed-saving, and natural building. A great place to learn sustainable skills in a quiet, community-focused setting.
